1. Extend the image with the border mode by half its size, at most 256 pixels, on each side.
2. Start with the estimate f equal to the extended image g.
3. Blur f with h through the FFT and divide g by the result.
4. Blur the ratio with h' and multiply f by it.
5. Repeat for the chosen number of iterations.
6. Crop the last estimate to the image.
